name: Pending Verifications
query:
SELECT
  vr.name as "Request:Link/Verification Request:160",
  vr.party_type as "Party Type::150",
  vr.party as "Party::180",
  vr.verification_type as "Type::100",
  vr.status as "Status::100",
  vr.creation as "Requested On:Datetime:160"
FROM `tabVerification Request` vr
WHERE vr.status = 'Pending'
ORDER BY vr.creation ASC
